description: Forms presented in labour, in pain, pre-medicated, or minutes before theatre, when declining is not practically available.
energy_note: Signed at the one moment she could not say no.

aspect: Alternatives not offered are not refused
description: Where only one option is described, the patient's agreement is recorded as a choice between options she was never told about.
energy_note: Consented to the only thing she was told existed.

description: 'Just going to have a quick look.' He is already doing it. There are two students at the end of the bed whose presence was not mentioned. Afterwards she cannot decide whether anything happened that she is entitled to be upset about.
energy_note: Not sure, afterwards, whether she is allowed to mind.
